buzzandbloom.title: Buzz & Bloom — Jeffrey Assavedo
buzzandbloom.meta_description: Buzz & Bloom case study — creative direction, content creation and social media management for a cocktails and mocktails brand.

hero.role: Graphic Designer, Content Creator & Social Media Manager · Cocktails & Mocktails
hero.lede: A creative and social media partnership built from concept through execution — shaping the visual presence, content production and Instagram strategy for a growing cocktails and mocktails brand.

brief.intro: Buzz & Bloom is a growing cocktails and mocktails brand focused on its products and social-first content.
brief.details: The work centered on building a consistent visual presence and turning the brand's products and ideas into content people could actually engage with.
details_column: Role: Graphic Designer, Content Creator & Social Media Manager
Scope: Shoot planning, photography, creative concepts, content production and Instagram management
Content: Product showcases, lifestyle content, promotions and campaign-led social posts

items.label: Planning
items.desc: Planned creative shoots around the brand's content needs, moving ideas from concept into production.

items.label: Content
items.desc: Produced visual content designed to give the cocktails and mocktails brand a recognizable and consistent presence.

items.label: Direction
items.desc: Developed concepts around the products, lifestyle and promotional moments shown across the brand's social channels.

items.label: Social
items.desc: Managed the brand's Instagram presence and translated the creative direction into consistent social output.

work_section.callout: Approach: Keep the creative process connected — plan the shoot, produce the assets, then carry the same thinking through the social platform.

outcome.text: Over a year of consistent content creation and community engagement, Buzz & Bloom developed a recognizable Instagram presence with strong product imagery, engaged followers and a clear visual direction.

tropibite.title: TropiBite — Jeffrey Assavedo
tropibite.meta_description: TropiBite case study — graphic design, content creation and social media management for a tropical juice and wellness brand.

hero.role: Graphic Designer & Social Media Manager · Food & Beverage
hero.lede: Building a visual presence and social strategy for a tropical juice and wellness brand focused on fresh, natural products and community engagement.

brief.intro: TropiBite is a food and beverage brand specializing in tropical coconut water, pineapple and mango products.
brief.details: The project focused on building a recognizable brand presence from the ground up — creating consistent visual identity, product photography, and social content strategy.
details_column: Role: Graphic Designer & Social Media Manager
Scope: Product photography, brand design, content creation, social media strategy and community management
Content: Product showcases, launch campaigns, lifestyle content, UGC and promotional material

items.label: Brand Design
items.desc: Developed the brand color palette (mint green, bright yellow, peach, cream) and visual system for consistent product presentation.

items.label: Photography
items.desc: Created product photography showcasing coconut water, pineapple, mango and lifestyle imagery.

items.label: Campaigns
items.desc: Designed promotional campaigns and countdowns for product launches with engaging CTAs.

items.label: Content
items.desc: Built content calendar with Reels, product features, UGC and lifestyle content.

work_section.callout: Strategy: Build a recognizable brand presence across social by connecting visual design, product storytelling and community engagement.

outcome.text: TropiBite established a fresh, cohesive brand presence across social platforms with consistent visual identity, engaged community and growing product visibility.

greywithsign.title: Greywith the Sign — Jeffrey Assavedo
greywithsign.meta_description: Greywith the Sign case study — social media management and creative support for a Ghanaian content creator.

hero.lede: A social media project built around simple signs, everyday Ghanaian humour and ideas people can instantly relate to.

brief.intro: Help build and manage a social presence where the content is simple, funny and rooted in everyday observations.
brief.details: The project centered on sign-holding street content that captures Ghanaian humour and universal relatability.
details_column: Role: Social Media Manager & Creative Support
Content format: Sign-holding street content, short-form social posts and topical humour
Audience: Ghanaian and wider social-media audiences

items.label: Ideas
items.desc: Developed simple, relatable sign concepts around humour, opinions and everyday life.

items.label: Production
items.desc: Helped shape the format and execution of the sign-based content.

items.label: Social
items.desc: Managed the social side of the content and kept the page consistent.

items.label: Publishing
items.desc: Turned finished ideas into posts built for engagement and shareability.

work_section.callout: The idea: Put a simple sign in a real place, give people something worth reacting to, and let the moment do the work.

outcome.text: Greywith the Sign built a loyal following through simple, relatable content that connected Ghanaian audience with universal observations, humour and authentic everyday moments.

upwork.title: Upwork — Jeffrey Assavedo
upwork.meta_description: Jeffrey Assavedo — freelance work on Upwork across AI data annotation and creative tasks.

hero.lede: A freelance track I've kept alongside my creative work — taking on AI and creative tasks through Upwork when projects fit.

brief.intro: Upwork has been a flexible freelance lane alongside my creative work.
brief.details: Taking on AI data annotation, video editing, proofreading and translation projects across a range of clients.
details_column: Scope: AI annotation, video editing, proofreading, translation

items.label: AI Data
items.desc: Annotation and evaluation work for AI-related projects.

items.label: Video
items.desc: Editing and preparing video content for project needs.

items.label: Proofreading
items.desc: Reviewing text for clarity, accuracy and consistency.

work_section.callout: Approach: Keep freelancing flexible—take on work that builds different skills without making it the primary focus.

outcome.text: Upwork gave me a way to build experience across different kinds of digital work, without making freelancing my main focus. It's a skill-building track that runs parallel to creative projects.
